comparison.objective: Remove a push-and-turn medicine-bottle cap without overturning the vial.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize the vial while applying sustained axial pressure and rotary motion to disengage a cap.
comparison.success_condition: Cap fully off; vial never knocked over; loose cap earns partial credit.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests coaxial mandrel placement, a separately delivered hammer impulse, notch fracture, and recovery of four fragments. Cap unlocking is sustained press-and-turn removal with no impact, fracture, or fragment containment.
